subject: general
question: In Africa, Kilimanjaro is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**a volcanic mountain.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mount Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcano in Tanzania, Africa. 
 
• It has three volcanic cones: Kibo, Mawenzi, and Shira.
 
• It is the highest mountain in Africa.
